text:
Alana: Heads up — onboarding nova-7b v2.0 weights landed but I can't find shard_02.bin in our S3 mirror. HF origin shows it. Anyone know where the registry copy is?
Cheng: I pushed manifest v3 earlier, pinged hashbot to verify. path I used: s3://rwd-artifacts/models/nova/7b/v2/weights/
Emily: Can you paste the full HF model id? gives quick lookup
Alana: `hf:nova-ai/nova-7b-v2`
Mike: We mirror via mirror-worker; sometimes shard files end up under staging. Try s3://rwd-artifacts/staging/nova-7b/v2/shards/
Priya: If checksum mismatch, ask CI to re-download. Which checksum do you have?
Alana: origin MD5: 9f8a7e2c... but registry's manifest lists sha256: abc123... Confusing. I ran `sha256sum shard_02.bin` locally and got abc123xyz
ingest-bot: mirror-worker: replicate job 4821 completed for hf:nova-ai/nova-7b-v2 -> registry. Status: partial (missing shard_02.bin).
Cheng: That's the key — manifest v3 probably got generated before full copy. I'll check the mirror logs. @Mike can you escalate job 4821 and retry presign?
Mike: On it. Re-running replicate job; also generating presign links for the missing file. ETA 10m.
Emily: Tokenizer note: this model uses space-prefixed tokens. Ensure tokenizer.json has `"add_prefix_space": true` in registry manifest, otherwise padding mismatches.
Priya: Also check config flags: `use_kv_cache: true`, `rotary_dim: 64` — those were missed in previous onboards.
Alana: Thanks. If presign works, can you drop link? I'll update the manifest and re-run the checksum CI.
Mike: Presign: https://rwd-presign.s3.amazonaws.com/3160001111/shard_02.bin?X (valid 1h). I also set ACL read-only for sync-service role.
Cheng: I patched manifest -> version v3.1 with updated checksum and tokenizer flag. Deployed to registry.
ingest-bot: ci-check: checksum-verify passed for all shards. Build 7829
Alana: Verified locally. Ready to mark onboarding ready. Can we schedule a small canary run on dedicated cluster tomorrow? @Emily @Priya
Emily: Yes, scheduled 09:30 PT. I'll coordinate canary config (batching 8, max_latency 120ms).
Priya: Will add quantization suggestion note to the onboarding ticket — avoid q4f16 for this one.
Alana: :thumbsup: closing loop. Thanks everyone.
